header.function_name: XD09 Mapping Customer Order and PO Batch

objective: To get the open qty of the crossdock customer orders (H0253, order status 7, Hold Flag N) in the H0253 order, pre-map them to the crossdock supplier PO parts (Pra Daily Order: manifests with TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST.CROSS_DOCK_FLAG = 'X'; their part data from TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART (join MANIFEST_NO)), cut them into supplier cases and blocks (ASN options) into the temporary table #TEMP_INSTRUCTION.

To give ASN Crossdock Creation (XD10) the delivery plan per Part Number + Customer Order Date with Case Qty, PO Readiness (case), the ASN options (blocks that can be sent) and the status Ready / Partially Ready / Not Ready.
It runs when the user clicks [Search] on XD10; there is no scheduler. The real mapping is done later by [Create ASN] on XD10.

Crossdock PO (decided 20-Oct): the order is taken from the manifest with TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST.CROSS_DOCK_FLAG = 'X' and its part data from TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART (MANIFEST_NO). The PO line is identified by MANIFEST_NO + MANIFEST_ITEM (PO_ITEM can differ from MANIFEST_ITEM; one PO can have several manifests).

steps: The user clicks [Search] on ASN Crossdock Creation (XD10) with Delivery Date and Rit. The previous content of the temporary table of the session is cleared.

steps.text: Get the customer order lines from TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE:
children: ORDER_STATUS = '7' (Cross Dock), UPD_STATUS IS NULL (no status change in G-System), HOLD_FLAG = 'N', PO_MAPPED_FLAG = 'N'; latest data; open qty = ORDER_STATUS_QTY - qty of the line already in TB_R_INSTRUCTION (> 0). Lines changed in G-System (UPD_STATUS '6' / '2', set by XD08) are not taken.
Get: Customer Code, Customer Order No, Order Date, Order Time, Destination Code, Detailed Item No, Serial No, Part Number, Order Status Qty; Pcs/Case of the part from TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.

steps.text: Get the PO parts from TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST + TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART:
children: manifests with TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST.CROSS_DOCK_FLAG = 'X'; their part data from TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART (join MANIFEST_NO); latest data; open PO qty = ORDER_QTY - MAPPED_QTY of TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MAPPED (0 when no row) > 0; ordered by Order Date ascending (FIFO).
Get: PO Number, Manifest Number, Supplier Code / Plant, Sub Supplier Code / Plant, Order Type, Dock Code, PO Order Qty, Order Date, ETD Ori, Manifest Item, Part Number.

steps.text: Per unit (Part Number + Customer Order Date, oldest date first), pre-map in H0253 order (see 4.1 and 4.2) and insert the result in #TEMP_INSTRUCTION.
children: Lines in H0253 order: 1) Allocation Priority (= Customer Order Date), 2) Customer Code, 3) Customer Order No, 4) Customer Order Date, 5) Customer Order Time, 6) Destination Code, 7) Detailed Item No, 8) Serial No.
Each PO qty (PO_DT ascending) goes to the open qty in this order; a line may be split over several POs.
The pcs are cut into supplier cases of PCS_CASE pcs in this order (a case can hold several lines and destinations); each slice line x PO x case is one row.

steps.text: Mark the valid cuts, number the blocks, set the status of each block and return the delivery plan to XD10 (see 4.3).
children: Error: clear the temporary table, show the error on the screen and record the Log (FAILED).

func_desc.text: This function builds the delivery plan of ASN Crossdock Creation on demand. It only pre-maps: nothing permanent is changed; the real mapping is done by [Create ASN] (XD10).

items: Customer Order Date (today, D) → PO Date (tomorrow, D+1): one PO per Part Number per Customer Order Date.

Total customer order qty of all destinations per Part Number and Customer Order Date = total PO qty of that PO. When the PO qty is lower: abnormality; the rest comes in a split PO, the customer orders without PO wait (Not Ready) until the next PO is issued.
One customer order line can be in different ASNs (its cases split). When G-System receives them separately, the line is split in H0253 (new SERIAL_NO); each part stays linked to its ASN (XD08).
PO_MAPPED_FLAG is set by [Create ASN] ('Y' when the whole line is in the ASN; a draft not submitted is released by XD08).
Ready cases of the delivery plan are sent following the cut (CUT_FLAG): the supplier selects from case 1 up to a cut; the cases between two cuts are sent together.

Per Part Number the oldest Customer Order Date is sent first (no skip): a later date can be selected only when every case of the earlier dates is in an ASN or selected in the same ASN. A Not Ready case of an earlier date holds the later dates. Lines on hold are not counted.

XD09 reads the H0253 replicate in this fixed order (decided 21-Oct): 1) Allocation Priority (= Customer Order Date), 2) Customer Code, 3) Customer Order No, 4) Customer Order Date, 5) Customer Order Time, 6) Destination Code, 7) Detailed Item No, 8) Serial No.
The order is applied per unit = Part Number + Customer Order Date (way B): the units of a part are processed by Customer Order Date ascending, so the POs go to the oldest date first.

Keys 2) to 8) are the primary key of TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE (same columns, same order). The PK order is global (all parts, dates and statuses) and a read without ORDER BY has no guaranteed order: XD09 filters the unit and reads it with ORDER BY SHIPPING_PART_NO, Allocation Priority (ORDER_DT), then the PK columns (query: Appendix). SORT_SEQ = ROW_NUMBER() in this order per unit (it can be derived again at any time).

Lines with HOLD_FLAG = 'Y' are not taken. Only the open qty of a line is taken (open qty = ORDER_STATUS_QTY - qty of the line already in TB_R_INSTRUCTION): a line can be sent over several ASNs; PO_MAPPED_FLAG becomes 'Y' only when the whole line is in TB_R_INSTRUCTION.
PO parts by PO_DT ascending; each PO qty goes to the open qty in H0253 order; a line may be split over several POs; qty without PO = PO_NO NULL.

The pcs of the unit are cut into supplier cases of PCS_CASE pcs in H0253 order (e.g. 6 pcs/case: case 1 = V01 6; case 2 = V01 4 + T01 2). A supplier case can hold several lines and destinations. G-System releases each destination in multiples of PCS_CASE, so every case is full.
A PO remainder without open line stays open for later customer orders.

In the warehouse 1 case = 1 destination (max PCS_CASE pcs). An ASN may therefore stop only after a case where the cumulative qty of every destination of the unit is a multiple of PCS_CASE (valid cut, CUT_FLAG 'Y'). SEQ_QTY = fill of the warehouse case of the destination (1..PCS_CASE, starts again after PCS_CASE): the cut is valid when the last SEQ_QTY of every destination = PCS_CASE. Example: after case 2 VN 10 / TH 2 is not valid (VN short 2, TH short 4); after case 3 VN 12 / TH 6 is valid.
Block = the cases after the previous valid cut up to the next valid cut (GROUP_SEQ). A block is never split.

CROSSDOCK_STATUS of a block: '6' Ready when the block and every earlier block are fully pre-mapped to a PO; '7' Not Ready otherwise. A later block with PO stays '7' while an earlier block has no PO (blocks are never skipped).

ASN options of the unit = the first 1..n Ready blocks. Unit status on XD10: Ready (all blocks '6'), Partially Ready (first block '6', a later block '7'), Not Ready (first block '7'). Units without any pre-mapped case are not listed.

The mapped qty per PO is kept in TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MAPPED; it is updated by [Create ASN] on XD10, not by this function. Nothing is saved by this function: #TEMP_INSTRUCTION is the pre-mapping only.

Query: H0253 lines in H0253 order (Allocation Priority = Customer Order Date)
WITH MAPPED AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_CD, CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO, ORDER_DT, DESTINATION_CD, DETAILED_ITEM_NO, SERIAL_NO, SUM(QTY) AS MAPPED_QTY
FROM TB_R_INSTRUCTION
GROUP BY CUSTOMER_CD, CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO, ORDER_DT, DESTINATION_CD, DETAILED_ITEM_NO, SERIAL_NO),
OPEN_LINE AS (SELECT H.*, H.ORDER_DT AS ALLOCATION_PRIORITY,
H.ORDER_STATUS_QTY - COALESCE(M.MAPPED_QTY, 0) AS OPEN_ORDER_QTY
FROM TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE H
LEFT JOIN MAPPED M ON M.CUSTOMER_CD = H.CUSTOMER_CD AND M.CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO = H.CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO
AND M.ORDER_DT = H.ORDER_DT AND M.DESTINATION_CD = H.DESTINATION_CD
AND M.DETAILED_ITEM_NO = H.DETAILED_ITEM_NO AND M.SERIAL_NO = H.SERIAL_NO
WHERE H.ORDER_STATUS = '7' AND H.UPD_STATUS IS NULL AND H.HOLD_FLAG = 'N' AND H.PO_MAPPED_FLAG = 'N')
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SHIPPING_PART_NO, ORDER_DT
ORDER BY ALLOCATION_PRIORITY, CUSTOMER_CD, CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO, ORDER_DT, ORDER_TIME,
DESTINATION_CD, DETAILED_ITEM_NO, SERIAL_NO) AS SORT_SEQ,
SHIPPING_PART_NO, ALLOCATION_PRIORITY, CUSTOMER_CD, CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO, ORDER_DT, ORDER_TIME,
DESTINATION_CD, DETAILED_ITEM_NO, SERIAL_NO, ORDER_STATUS_QTY, OPEN_ORDER_QTY
FROM OPEN_LINE
WHERE OPEN_ORDER_QTY > 0
ORDER BY SHIPPING_PART_NO, ALLOCATION_PRIORITY, CUSTOMER_CD, CUSTOMER_ORDER_NO, ORDER_DT, ORDER_TIME,
DESTINATION_CD, DETAILED_ITEM_NO, SERIAL_NO

tables.name: #TEMP_INSTRUCTION
tables.description: Temporary table of one Search run (session): the open qty of the customer order lines (H0253, order status 7, Hold Flag N) in H0253 order, pre-mapped to the supplier POs (Pra Daily Order) and cut into supplier cases and blocks. One row per line x PO x supplier case; PO_NO NULL for the qty still without a PO. Columns proposed.
columns: H0253 order of the line within the unit (refer 4.1)
Customer Order Date (H0253.ORDER_DT; unit and order key 3)
Order status qty of the customer order line (H0253.ORDER_STATUS_QTY)
Qty of the line not yet in TB_R_INSTRUCTION (sent or in an open Case List)
Qty of this slice (line x PO x supplier case)
Supplier PO number (Pra Daily Order Manifest); NULL while not assigned
Manifest item number (Pra Daily Order Part)
Order date of the PO (PO Date)
Order qty of the PO part
Pcs per case of the part (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.PCS_CASE)
Supplier case of the slice within the unit (PCS_CASE pcs in H0253 order)
Sequence of the slice within the case
Cumulative qty of the destination within the unit up to this slice
Fill of the warehouse case (1 case = 1 destination) of the destination after this slice: 1..PCS_CASE, starts again after PCS_CASE
'Y' on the last slice of a case after which the ASN may stop (every destination a multiple of PCS_CASE)
Case Group (block) of the slice: the cases up to and including a valid cut; the cases of a group are sent together
Status of the block: '6' Ready (the block and every earlier block have a PO) / '7' Not Ready
